working_tree: Uncommitted integration on main; existing compiler/cohort changes preserved.

scope.timed: Startup excluding fixture read/verification, graph sources, source preparation, metadata inventory/reservation, producer constructors, final metadata schedule and memory closure.
scope.stop: After derive_metadata_complete and metadata installation; before execute_constructed_case, runtime preissue and recursive proof execution.
scope.retirement: Incomplete metadata case owners stay live until isolated process teardown; no case completion receipt is minted.

implementation: Select compatible idle reservation slots by minimum additional host/device growth; preserve live inputs and failure owners.
Use authenticated child heights and source-derived packed program, proof-input and identity-prefix retained bounds; enforce actual retained capacities.
Charge frozen owner-table payload backing once and sequential forwarding frames as phase scratch; keep full construction/growth-overlap and preissue allowances.
Expand independently qualified native tables from 159 to 304 rows, including 120 SHAKE and 25 new affine recipes; bound table capacity at 512 rows.
Keep the native LRU at 256 entries; increase its source-bound allowance from 1 to 2 MiB for bounded inventory, and report explicit lookup/fallback reasons.
Batch f0 signed subtraction through the existing GPU vector operation and reuse scope-owned public NTT/multiplication layouts; preserve owner checks and scope poisoning.
Add verified public N3 fixture replay, detailed stage/source-preparation timing, cache rates and strict metadata-only acceptance.

methodology.identity_hashing: CPU; existing automatic concurrency and 16-physical-core affinity unchanged while metadata worker counts vary.
methodology.cache: Empty process caches at startup with qualified static numeric tables enabled.
methodology.fixtures: Fresh native inputs generated once, public statements and native proofs captured, then deterministic replay. Private randomness and witnesses are not serialized.
methodology.baseline: Frozen integrated compiler/cohort baseline plus replay instrumentation; all nine attempts stop at CombinedAdmission.
methodology.optimized: All nine runs and one independently generated heldout fixture complete the metadata boundary.
methodology.order: Baseline nine runs precede optimization; optimized repeats ordered 1/8/16, 16/8/1, 1/8/16, then heldout 16.
methodology.metric: metadata_elapsed_ns = timing.total_ns + generation_and_startup_ns - fixture_load_verify_ns; no native input generation in replay.
methodology.qualification: Local scoped metadata timings; guard performance_qualified and benchmark fields remain false. These are not full-workflow performance receipts.

cache_coverage.meaning: misses counts LRU misses, including static table hits; cold compilation misses = misses - table_hits. These are software descriptor-cache rates, not hardware cache-miss counters.
cache_coverage.registered_request_change: Authenticated child heights introduce more exact registered lookups; all are memory or qualified-table hits.

memory.interpretation: Source-bound future reservation accounting, not measured RSS. The baseline is 4.111581 GiB over the 32 GiB worker limit. The optimized outer-backend residual deliberately fills the remaining allowance, so required_host equals the cap; this does not imply actual peak usage or spare runtime capacity.

numeric_qualification.generation: Both tables regenerated from these independent CPU compilation records. Both generator --check commands passed; final lookup-use test and all ten optimized fixtures hit the source-qualified tables.

validation.real_gpu_parity: Existing NTT, multiplication and signed subtraction match CPU, with scope poisoning after checked failure; zero recursive proofs.
validation.note: GPU parity and core qualification precede final table regeneration. Tables are checked against their qualification records; the final research binary verifies active table use.

provenance.raw_records: Raw logs, receipt hashes, build/executable identities and complete source manifests are retained in local .tools paths referenced by each run.

limitations: Baseline timings are incomplete attempts, not successful complete-stage measurements.
The synthetic N3 fixtures qualify these public descriptors and this host, not every RingCT layout or production workload.
No ablation run isolates the speedup of each change.
The GPU metadata compiler port remains deferred; no new GPU kernels were introduced.
Recursive proving and runtime ownership retirement were not exercised by the metadata-only benchmark.
